caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The chart is a nested pie chart, consisting of two rings with a total of seven slices. The inner ring has three slices, representing 'Max: 1' (darkest blue, 49.0%), 'Max: 2' (medium blue, 38.0%), and 'Max: 3' (lightest blue, 14.2%), while the outer ring has four slices, representing 'Std: 0.0' (darkest blue, 7.0%), 'Std: 0.47' (dark blue, 47.7%), 'Std: 0.82' (medium blue, 39.0%), and 'Std: 0.94' (light blue, 5.0%). Percentage labels are placed inside each slice. A legend is provided to the right of the chart, explaining the color coding for both the inner and outer rings. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way beyond their categorization.
